## About This Event

## Motivational Session by Successful Entrepreneur / Start-Up Founder

Date:30 September 2024Time:09:30 AM – 1:00 PMSpeaker:Mr. K. Surya Prakash, CEO – Deeloop TechnologiesOverview:An inspiring motivational talk where Mr. Surya Prakash shared his entrepreneurial journey, challenges, and lessons learned from building Deeloop Technologies. The session encouraged students to develop entrepreneurial mindsets and take initiative in innovation.
